container_interface: Initial revision The provides a command-line executable for running a container with libcontainer. The program assumes the following: 1. Add Wacom touch FW updater script This CL adds a touch firmware updater script for Wacom touch sensors. This should check the firmware version on disk and compare it to the current active FW version and update it accordingly. CQ-DEPEND=CL:366000 BUG=chromium:624262 TEST=deployed on a device including a Wacom touchscreen and rebooted, the firmware script updates the firmware when needed and chooses not to when the firmware version is up to date. Support EV_MSC event types for ChromeOS A vendor reported the remote chromeos support crashing when EV_MSC events were emitted by their touch device. This seems to be due to evtest reporting those events as hexidecimal values instead of base-10. According to evtest's source there are only 2 events that it does this for, so this CL adds in a check for those events in an attempt to parse them correctly. BUG=chromium:627506 TEST=manually tested, then verified by the vendor Change-Id: I268abe40e744c9dace0ded9082abbf1a52913f4c Signed-off-by: Charlie Mooney <charliemooney@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/359945 Reviewed-by: Andrew de los Reyes <adlr@chromium.org>

[autotest]only accept hosts when both hosts and meta_hosts given for a clone job When cloning a job via autotest frontend, if user chooses the default clone action, which is 'Reuse any similar hosts' and then later still select specific hosts in the next tab, the host scheduler will get confused about the case and would try to schedule two same jobs to one host. In this case, the host scheduler will crash because of duplicate entries for one job in the database. The fix is to only accept the hosts variables under this situation. CHROMIUM: arm: dts: disable EDMA on gale EVT2 ESS/EDMA isn't connected on gale EVT2 (and older) units. This change sets the edma/switch/mdio nodes to disabled so they are no longer visible to respective drivers. The problem is the "fake" EDMA eth0/eth1 devices were racing with (and winning over) the Allspark-E to get "wan0" name. And thus, the "external" routes weren't getting set up. BUG=b:30743425 TEST=buld/boot on gale evt2 with Allspark-E. Verify (1) "route -n" shows wan0 and (2) "ethtool -i wan0" shows "driver: r8152" . ts_mon_config: Don't pickle metrics objects Fixed the ts_mon flushing process to receive metrics without pickling metrics objects. When we pickle metrics objects, they carry a reference to the metrics store in the ts_mon module, which is then recreated in the flushing process when the metric is unpickled - therefore, the metric never gets sent to the proper metrics store in the flushing process. The fix is to just use metric names and look up the metric in the chromite.lib.metrics library with getattr() when the metric is received.
